review:
I like the UI of UBER app more than any other  apps of this category. I often wonder, why there are only 2 payment methods to opt in the app - Paytm and Card, in the IOS version and there is no focus on the payment methods inspite of the regular updates released. I wish new payment methods like addition of UPIs would help users in a great way and you will include it in your future updates.
Paytm payment method has a bug, especially when adding money to paytm and paying. Though the addition of money gets successful, an error is shown in the UBER app, amd once we click on the cross mark and try to pay with paytm again, the added money will be deducted and the payment gets done. Hope this will also be addressed in the future updates as it’s annoying.
Notifications are received to complete the payment in the app after completion of the ride, if the payment method opted for the app is card. But when you click on it, you will land in the UBER app and the booking screen appears. Boom!! There is no way in the payment section also to complete payment for the previous trip. Only way you can complete the payment is to try bookinv another ride and it prompts you about the outstanding amount. If this could be fixed, the time taken to book a cab will be reduced as currently one has to complete the payment and then book the cab in case of outstanding amount. 

Thanks!!

Uber as an online platform is great. Having said that, there is considerable scope in improving the in-field experience of the passenger. The foremost and vital part is cab drivers accepting the ride request and not turning up. They cancel the ride or delay it so much that forces the passenger to cancel and rebook another ride. This makes the passenger liable for cancellation charges. A very unfair situation, not to mention the missed flight/train/appointment and the attendant stress that the passenger goes through. I have faced this problem in Pune majorly and Delhi NCR on a number of occassions. Next issue is the cleanliness of the cabs. Some cabs are spotlessly clean and well maintained but then there are a few cabs which should really not be on the road. Lastly and rarely is the issue of cab driver behaviour. Sleepy cab drivers, though rare, is a serious issue that needs to be addressed scientifically.  The Uber needs to work with other aggregators like Ola to ensure that cab drivers do not work beyond reasonable hours to make more money. I have had three situations where the cab driver was exhausted due to long hours and very sleepy. In one case I had to take over driving duty to prevent serious accident. In another case the driver was sleepy and the cab met with an accident. The passenger may himself be sleepy and not in a position to intervene suitably. The onus is on Uber to work towards providing a safe ride. Thanks for asking for the feedback.

This is a review specific to Uber india. Yesterday October 30th was the final nail in the coffin for my Uber experience as it has just deteriorated from a convenience to struggle. We were looking for an Uber to drive us to a location which was only about an half hour away. The first driver had to drop his previous customer and took 25 minutes over the scheduled time and only told me about this after I tried to call him. After asking him to cancel since we were in a hurry so we could get another booking he was rude. This was not the end of the story.. we were then redirected to another driver who was 2 minutes away which we thought was a relief. But that person decided that the best time to go and refill his Cars fuel was to do it after he has accepted a fare. On trying to contact him he mentioned that he will take 20 minutes more to fill up. Which added to the frustration that why would these drivers accept and have no consideration for the customers time. Upon asking him as told why he accepted when he knew he had told fill up he began cursing … 2 drivers on the same night … UBER india are you guys so desperate that you will hire these goons to represent you ? Safe to say we will never use Uber again after these incidents

Today, the Uber driver said that because of congestion totalling a delay of 7 min he won’t take the highway route and literally was in mood to drop me midway as he was in a hurry and I objected that I have to go from highway only. To my shock his AC was not working - got to work in the last 5 min of overall 30 min trip and he shouted on me when I said I won’t want to go from other route. He finally took highway and I didn’t complain Uber during the trip and later gave one star rating to the driver. The driver also gave me 1 star rating. There is no way I can contact Uber after the trip is completed and because of AC being deliberately shut down I am so much drenched in sweat in office plus my mood got so off plus I can’t complain Uber plus there is no distinction in giving driver one star rating as he too gave me one star rating. What the heck is this ? I won’t book an Uber cab from now on but is this the way to treat customers !!

The fact that the same complaints are repeating and still they have the nerve to say this will not happen again is amazing. We avail your services and give you business because we appreciate your service. In return, your driver partners give us hostile treatment, hurl insults and threaten us. 
It has come to a point where I have to think twice before booking a cab from Uber and if I did, I have to pray for my safety and hope that the driver is not going to be a bad person.
If it is going to be this way, then I will stop using the service hence forward because the company is too big shot to care about the service. If money is your only focus then please earn it the right way. Don’t make a hole in customer’s pocket and take theirs.

Shuttle Service - On the recommendation of few friends, I purchased Shuttle package and started using Shuttle services. I was told that I will be getting 25% off on purchasing 25 trips package. I observed that the package was getting over in no time. When I reconciled with the number of trips I had actually availed and the number of trips which got deducted, I found a discrepancy there. Excess trips were being deducted when these weren’t availed. I wrote a mail and explained the situation. Every time I received the same standardised reply that they understand the situation but couldn’t do anything about it. They do not understand the customer’s concern and reply as if they are machines. There is no call centre where you can ask for immediate support as well. Eventually the 25%  discount which they claimed to provide is all faux since I ended up paying for a 25 trip package when I had actually availed only 12 trips. 

Cab service - After booking a cab, the cab driver will call you up after 5 to 7 minutes and ask what is the destination. Once I inform it, he will ask to cancel the cab since he has to go to his home. If at the first place he wasn’t interested, why did he accept and wait for 5 minutes? He shouldn’t have accepted the ride. We all are left at the mercy of these cab drivers and Uber isn’t concerned with this as no action gets taken.  They hardly take any feedback from the customer. For them, money is more important than customers.

The driver after making us wait for 45 mins did not turn up at the pick up point, since it was late in the night and we were travelling with some female companions.. we were in a hurry to reach home.. when contacted the driver, he bluntly said that he won’t be coming to pick us up and that we should cancel the booking, when I tried to reason with the driver that, it’s his fault that he failed to pick us up so he should be the one to cancel it.. he simply replied.. then wait there till morning, am not coming.. this was the most unprofessional and disgusting attitude from a service provider.. they don’t even have a customer care no where you can lodge a complaint.. their e-mail complaint redressal.. well lesser said the better,  am still waiting for their team to get in touch with me.. the worst part is the same thing happened with me twice again this week.. and every time I have been stranded and forced to cancel my ride, I have been forced to pay the fine too.. this is just nothing but TRUE DAY LIGHT ROBBERY..

The app lets you complain about drivers and drivers to complain about riders, but there is nowhere to complain about the app. And half the time the problem is neither with the drivers nor the riders but the app itself. For over 4 years the app has not managed to get my home pick up stop correctly though I travel daily. Everyday I have to trek halfway into a side road to catch my ride. It has no flexibility to pick up on preferred routes even if you travel everyday. This becomes a problem when you know a particular road has construction and cannot be used but the app will continue to give drivers that option as the preferred route. The traffic assessment is abysmal and route choices are illogical- often over the bumpiest side roads (for what to avoid traffic? but the speed is very slow on bad roads anyway). Pricing is extortionary. And fleet size poor. For the promises of vertical integration the final delivery has most of the problems (high prices and low flexibility on routes and timings) and few benefits. This review has built up over several years of daily exasperation.

Uber drivers keep cancelling the rides constantly. The call and ask for drop location and cancel the rides and I’m left stranded waiting for the drivers to change. This can even go up to an hour. The drivers have the audacity to tell us to cancel the ride because it will charge them to cancel on their end. During pickup, when they don’t want to come, they start taking longer routes or going to opposite direction. Eventually I need to cancel the ride because they will neither come nor cancel the ride. This becomes a cost to me. Uber needs to learn the customer support service from Ola. Ola has much better options to complain immediately even if the driver denies your ride, but Uber will charge the customer in such cases.

I was waiting in tears only to see my rides changing and Uber charging me for cancellation. Finally I got someone to book at Ola for me in one-go. 

I was stranded in tears because of Uber. I reached home safe because of Ola.

I booked other cab manually and went but I missed my train. I think Uber should add some features on their app where we can complain against these drivers and if something like this happens with someone they can complain and then these driver should be banned or suspend for some days so that they can learn their lesson and don’t take cancelling ride as a joke.

Just to be safe I've raised a police complaint on the driver where he received relatable punishment for trespassing into my house but the Uber support people unblocked my account after a full day argument with them. This is the kind of safety that they provide us. And the other issue I had faced was, when I book a ride with cash option at the end of the ride it changes to APP payment and I really don't know how it happens, because of their stupid wage policies the drivers are demanding cash only now this is a kind of scam that these Uber people are running currently, when I tried to contact them for tens and tens of times they keep forcing me to make the outstanding payment which was already fulfilled to the driver, even if I ask them to cross check the payment with the driver partner also they still force you to make the payment. This is the reason why it's wise to travel in public transports only.

I thought I almost miss my flight when the cab drivers were quickly changing by uber for reasons lesser known to be for my airport drop to Terminal 2 KIA Bengaluru. 
Almost an hour went past but no cab reached me raising my  concern and making me believe that I would miss my flight. It was then Elson was given my drop and I messaged him to come at earliest else I may miss my flight today. He made it to my pick up location  in slightly over ten minutes and conveyed me to airport just in time and I could check in well in time. 
The attitude, response to my request for help and driving skill to cut down traffic delay is praiseworthy. It’s even important to bring out the he is a South Indian and I am Punjabi and there was not much I could communicate to him in English or Hindi . But as a human being , he understood my need of the hour and pushed his limits to make me catch my flight.

So , Elson is a hero to me and through him Uber recovered it’s good will in my eyes. Kudos Elson!!

I have courts for that and I will take that route if I want to. I have used your service extensively in the past and not once but twice have I been conned by uber. The latest being the driver reaching my destination without me as it was closer to him and ending the trip. Uber’s response was that I did not choose the payment method at the time of booking. 
That’s absolute hog-wash. Paytm is embedded into Uber app and I am not sure why i have to select it time and again. And the driver questions me as to why I did not tell him that I selected payTM and not cash. Since then I decided to stop using their service and the funny thing was it was for 54 rupees. The first time it was 900 bucks and the driver said his app was not working so he asked me to pay cash and I had to pay toll at the airport too which was not included in the fare. My recent trip was very nice.
